summary.text: Paul Honig was sworn into the Connecticut Senate in 2025 to represent the 8th Senate District, which includes Norfolk, Hartland, Canton, Simsbury, New Hartford, Avon and other towns.

paragraphs.text: He lives in Harwinton and is serving his third term on the town's Board of Selectmen.
Honig spent more than two decades in financial services, reaching managing director at JPMorgan Chase Bank, and has also worked as a mathematics teacher.
